news.label: llama.cpp reaches v1.0.0
points: Breaking changes mean a major bump
details: The inference library libllama and its foundation, ggml, have both reached version 1.0.0.

The project has made clear that any breaking change to the public C API will come with a major version bump. It supports more than 150 model architectures and runs on macOS, Linux, Windows, mobile, and more.

lines.say: First up, llama dot c p p has finally reached version one.
lines.show: First up, llama.cpp has finally reached version 1.

lines.say: Any change that breaks compatibility will now come with a major version bump.
lines.show: Any change that breaks compatibility will now come with a major version bump.

lines.say: Looks like the foundation of local A I has become a lot more stable.
lines.show: The foundation of local AI just got a lot more stable.

news.label: LoRA training for TRELLIS.2
details: A hands-on guide has been published for fine-tuning TRELLIS.2, which generates 3D models from images, using LoRA.

One experiment used 188 shoe 3D models to improve sole shapes, which are often inaccurate. Docker containers and scripts for preprocessing and training are provided, and the example uses an A100 80 gigabyte GPU.

lines.say: Next, Hugging Face has published a guide to fine-tuning TRELLIS dot two with LoRA.
lines.show: Next, Hugging Face has published a guide to fine-tuning TRELLIS.2 with LoRA.

news.label: SHINING 3D unveils EINSTAR EZ GO
details: It supports AI tracking, background separation, and markerless scanning.
It combines thirty cross laser lines, a single laser for fine detail, and infrared scanning. It connects wirelessly to smartphones and tablets and runs for up to about two hours on battery.

lines.say: Up next, SHINING three D's mobile scanner, the EINSTAR EZ GO.
lines.show: Up next: SHINING 3D's mobile scanner, the EINSTAR EZ GO.

lines.say: With A I tracking, it can scan without any markers.
lines.show: With AI tracking, it can scan without any markers.

lines.say: Being able to carry it around and capture shapes is pretty handy.

news.label: NVIDIA releases SOMA Retargeter
details: It converts BVH motion data using inverse kinematics, adapting it to a robot's body proportions and joint limits, and exports each frame's joint angles as CSV.
Version zero point two provides example configurations and sample motions for five robots, including the Unitree G1 and H2.

lines.say: Now to robotics. NVIDIA has released SOMA Retargeter, which turns human motion into robot joint movement.
lines.show: Now to robotics. NVIDIA has released SOMA Retargeter, which turns human motion into robot joint movement.

lines.say: The fun part is that you can try it without a physical robot.
lines.show: The fun part: you can try it without a physical robot.

link.title: Adapt Human Motion for Robots with NVIDIA SOMA Retargeter | NVIDIA Technical Blog
link.description: Human motion offers roboticists a great starting point for teaching humanoid robots how to move. A human demonstration captures the coordination and timing behind natural movement…

news.label: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Wallet
points: AI agents help you make purchases
details: You review the item, the total, and the payment card, then approve with biometrics or similar, and the purchase goes ahead.
The agent never receives your actual card details and uses a payment token instead. It launches first for ChatGPT Pro users in the US aged eighteen and over, and will roll out gradually through Dots.

lines.say: An A I agent can go ahead with a purchase once you've approved it.
lines.show: An AI agent can go ahead with a purchase once you've approved it.

lines.say: The key point is that your card details are never handed over.
lines.show: The key point: your card details are never handed over.

link.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
link.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet partners with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and those cardholders keep their existing credit card rewards.
